coaching.title: Easy 3 mi Z2 Rolling
coaching.message: 3 miles, ~500 ft of rolling vert, HR capped at 138-150 bpm (well under your 165 LTHR). This is Week 5 and the taper window opens in the next few days, so keep this one genuinely easy — no chasing pace on the climbs. Use the rollers to rehearse the short punchy grades you'll see in the Julian Alps rather than to build fatigue.

coaching.title: Fuel Right
coaching.message: Short easy effort, so no on-course fueling needed — just a light pre-run snack (banana or toast) if it's been over 3 hours since eating. Hit your ~220g carb target through the day to keep glycogen topped off, and use the run to test whatever gut-training strategy you're carrying into the race sim coming up.

coaching.title: Recovery
coaching.message: Load is light today, but you're stacked on travel (Lima → packing → flight to Miami tonight). Prioritize hydration and a short mobility flow before you pack, and bank sleep where you can around the travel window — recovery from the accumulated Week 5 volume matters more than the run itself right now.

coaching.title: Mental Edge
coaching.message: This is the last easy shakeout before the taper phase begins and before your race simulation. Three weeks out from Kranjska Gora, the work is banked — today's job is just to move well and stay sharp through the travel chaos, not to prove anything.
